summary: This bill amends federal pension law to bar annuity or retired pay for Members of Congress (or their survivors) convicted of rape, sexual assault, crimes of violence, bribery, fraud, or certain other offenses committed while in office, or determined by their House to have engaged in sexual conduct with a supervised staff member.
